caption:
Everything looks fine — so why does your faith feel thin? It didn't collapse. It just quietly blurred. (Galatians 1:6-7 devotional)

Nothing collapsed — and that's exactly what makes it dangerous. A blurred gospel keeps running under the same name while its center quietly shifts, and no one notices. It was never yours to make shinier or more impressive; it's a life to keep clear, so keep asking, “Is this still that gospel?”
